description: Machine-readable policy for the ClinicOps Tier-0 autonomy layer. The job registry below is derived from the YAML front matter of autonomy/jobs/*.md; tests/test_autonomy_rules.py fails when the two drift apart. Everything here is a ceiling, never a target.

0.label: autonomous
0.description: Research, monitoring, drafting, verification, terminology data building, EUDAMED research, SEO/content drafts, pipeline hygiene reports, invoice preparation and backups. Nothing outward-facing, nothing irreversible.
guardrails: drafts only; an Outlook or Gmail draft is allowed, sending is not
calendar events carry no external attendees and no invitations
pull requests only; never a push to main
private outputs stay in Drive ClinicOps-Autonomy and the private project

1.label: autonomous within standing orders
1.description: Actions Ali has pre-authorised by a written standing order. Not yet enabled: while enabled is false every Tier-1 action is parked as Tier 2 and released only with explicit human approval.
guardrails: HubSpot writes require Ali to re-authorise the connector; until then jobs report and propose only

2.label: prepared and parked for Ali
2.description: Prepared by automation, released only by Ali. The job produces the draft, the evidence and a NEEDS_ALI item; the action itself waits.
guardrails: LinkedIn publishing, site changes and outbound sends need Ali's case-by-case approval (00_STATE/GOVERNANCE_BOUNDARIES.md)

3.label: never automated
3.description: Done by Ali himself, never by automation, and never releasable by a human_approved flag: money, contracts, accounts, credentials, CAPTCHAs, compliance-status statements about a named party, Danish e-marketing, and anything that rewrites or deletes shared state.

policy_defaults.note: An action that appears in no tier list is denied (fail closed). human_approved releases Tier-1 and Tier-2 parks; it never releases a Tier-3 denial, a jurisdiction denial or a cap denial.

cold_email.dedupe_against: authoritative private outreach master plus live Sent history

DK.note: Danish-domiciled organisations are never cold-emailed or cold-messaged under any framing; public posting only.

DE.note: German recipients: UWG §7 applies; a cold email is parked with the legal basis named and released only by Ali.

AT.note: Austrian recipients: TKG §174 applies; a cold email is parked with the legal basis named and released only by Ali.

default.note: Every send is Tier 2: prepared, parked, released by Ali.

post_gate.rule: Sits in the whole value chain, not a Danish-only framing.
Teaches a real structure or failure mode.
Anchored to a real asset (a figure, a document, a dataset) with its source.
Verified at source: the primary source is quoted in a footnote; claim IDs come from research/claims.jsonl and respect allowed_uses.
Ali's confirmation. Every draft starts with 'DRAFT — requires user confirmation before publishing.' Automation never clears this item.

do_not_contact.pointer: Private list: 00_CONTROL/DO_NOT_CONTACT.md in the private project, or Drive ClinicOps-Autonomy/00_CONTROL/DO_NOT_CONTACT.md. Never copied into this repository.
do_not_contact.match_rule: Match on entity names, obvious variants and subsidiaries. A match is flagged 'must never be worked'; nothing else happens.

locations.rule: Create this file to stop every job; delete it to resume. Any content (not a 404) means HALT.
Google Drive search_files with query title = 'CLINICOPS_HALT'; any result means HALT.
Projects tool, if present: either doc existing means HALT.

outputs.public_path: Pull requests to aliiskandar310796-beep/ClinicOps on branches named autonomy/<topic>-<date>; never a push to main.

jobs.name: ClinicOps T0 Verification
outputs: pull request (best effort, never to main)

jobs.name: ClinicOps T0 Termbase
outputs: weekly PR to data/termbase/termbase_public.csv (public rows only)

watchdog.missed_rule: A job that has not fired within 2x its cadence_minutes is ALERT missed.
watchdog.short_run_rule: A run whose finished_at - fired_at is below min_expected_duration_seconds is WARN short run (probable fail-fast).
watchdog.scheduler_stall_rule: next_run_at more than 2 hours in the past is ALERT scheduler stall.
watchdog.disabled_rule: An expected job that is disabled or missing from the scheduler is ALERT.

claim_freshness.status_change_to_verified: Ali only; the verification job proposes, it never sets status to verified.
